name: example-domain
description: Minimal reference domain plugin showing how a downstream consumer integrates with conductor-kernel. Implements a single 'example' slash command that dispatches a 'example-agent' which delegates validation to conductor-kernel:critic. Read examples/example-domain/README.md before extending.

authors.name: conductor-kernel maintainers
authors.comment: Reference example — not a published plugin

_meta.purpose: Onboard a new contributor to conductor-kernel in under 30 minutes. Demonstrates: (1) plugin manifest shape; (2) slash-command verb dispatch into a domain agent; (3) cross-plugin dispatch into a kernel-provided validator; (4) audit-event emission via kernel.audit_emit. Does NOT demonstrate stream-mode, recovery, or memory primitives — see API.md for the full surface.
